inventoryprofiles.gui.config.title.zh: Inventory Profiles Next v%s 配置菜单

inventoryprofiles.common.gui.config.keyb.en:
- Left click to configure
- Right click to reset to defaults
inventoryprofiles.common.gui.config.keyb.zh:
- 左击进行配置
- 右击重置默认

inventoryprofiles.config.description.rel.en: Reload all rule.*.txt files from the config folder
inventoryprofiles.config.description.rel.zh: 重载配置文件夹中的规则文件： *.txt

inventoryprofiles.config.description.sor.en: The sorting method used for inventory sorting
inventoryprofiles.config.description.sor.zh: 物品栏整理的整理方法

inventoryprofiles.config.description.cus.en: The rule for custom sorting method
inventoryprofiles.config.description.cus.zh: 自定义整理方法的规则

inventoryprofiles.config.description.cre.en:
Since 1.19.3 "Creative Menu" have changed. And there are multiple possible interpretations of: "Sorted like the Creative Menu".

IPN now supports 2 way of ordering:
1. Like in the search tab
2. You can define category priority.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.cre.zh:
自1.19.3“创造菜单”已经改变。而且有多种可能的解释：“像创造菜单一样排序”。

IPN现在支持2种排序方式：
1.像在搜索标签页
2.你可以自定义类别优先级。

inventoryprofiles.config.description.cat.en: Creative Menu categories in order of priority to be used as Order Source for "Sort Order" "Creative Menu"
inventoryprofiles.config.description.cat.zh: 按优先级排列的创造菜单类别，用作“整理顺序”、“创意菜单”的订单源。

inventoryprofiles.config.description.cat.en:
This is here for convenience. It may change from server to server or world to world.
The idea is to copy, examine and reorder this if you want to seth the "Priority List" above.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.cat.zh:
这里是为了方便。它可能因服务器或世界的不同而改变。
这个想法是复制、检查和重新排序，如果你想对上面的“优先级列表”进行修改。

inventoryprofiles.config.description.mov.en: Holding this key while using move all/matching function will make it so that only existing stacks will be refilled on the target
inventoryprofiles.config.description.mov.zh: 使用移动全部/匹配功能时按住此键将使其仅在目标上重新填充现有组

inventoryprofiles.config.description.inc.en: Hold this key to include hotbar
inventoryprofiles.config.description.inc.zh: 按住此键以包含快捷栏

inventoryprofiles.config.description.mov.en: Hold this key to move/throw all
inventoryprofiles.config.description.mov.zh: 按住此键以移动/扔出全部物品

inventoryprofiles.config.description.mov.en:
Hold this key to move all the items of the type under the cursor or currently held in the cursor.
NOTE: This will move all the items of the selected type despite it already being present on the other side.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.mov.zh:
按住此键以仅移动鼠标所指/所持的物品种类
注意：这将会移动所有的指定物品，包括当前已在另一侧的物品。

inventoryprofiles.config.description.alw.en: Include hotbar without holding the modifier key (then holding the modifier key is to exclude hotbar)
inventoryprofiles.config.description.alw.zh: 不按热键即包含快捷栏物品 (按住热键排除快捷栏物品)

inventoryprofiles.config.description.alw.en: Move all without holding the modifier key (then holding the modifier key is to move matching items only)
inventoryprofiles.config.description.alw.zh: 不按热键即移动全部物品 (按住热键仅移动相符物品)

inventoryprofiles.config.description.alw.en: Throw all without holding the modifier key (the holding the modifier key is to throw matching items only)
inventoryprofiles.config.description.alw.zh: 不按热键即扔出全部物品 (按住热键仅扔出相符物品)

inventoryprofiles.config.description.hig.en: The color used when highlighting only the background of the slot.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.hig.zh: 仅突出显示槽背景时使用的颜色。

inventoryprofiles.config.description.hig.en: The color used when highlighting the whole slot.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.hig.zh: 突出显示整个槽时使用的颜色。

inventoryprofiles.config.description.hig.en: If true the highlight will be drown over the whole slot, if false only the background and not the item will be highlighted.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.hig.zh: 如果启用，高亮将覆盖整个槽位，关闭时则仅高亮背景不高亮物品。

inventoryprofiles.config.description.hig.en: If true the items highlight will blink, if false the highlight will be static.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.hig.zh: 如果启用，物品高亮将会闪烁，关闭时则会静态常亮。

inventoryprofiles.config.description.hig.en: If true all the items with the same type as the items under cursor will be highlighted.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.hig.zh: 如果启用，所有鼠标指向物品的相同物品都将会被高亮。

inventoryprofiles.config.name.profiles_p.zh: 开启世界/服务器独立的档案

inventoryprofiles.config.description.ena.en:
Enables profiles support.
Profiles are sets of gear you can switch between with a single button.

If you wanna learn how to setup the Profile Support go to the "Edit Profiles" page.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.ena.zh:
档案是你可以通过按键进行切换的一套装备。
如果你想要了解如何设置档案功能，请前往 "档案编辑" 页面。

inventoryprofiles.config.description.pro.en: If set to true you will have different set of profiles for every server you connect to.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.pro.zh: 如果启用，你将在你连接的每个服务器中有不同的档案。

inventoryprofiles.config.name.enable_loc.en: Enable Unique Locked Slots per World/Server
inventoryprofiles.config.name.enable_loc.zh: 开启世界/服务器独立的槽位锁定

inventoryprofiles.config.description.ena.en:
Locked slots are ignored for: sort, move all, clean cursor, continuous crafting supplies storage, auto refill supplies storage (auto refill monitoring slots are not affected). 
Notice:
Sorting in columns/rows only works if the shape of remaining non-locked slots is rectangular.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.ena.zh:
锁定槽位将被以下操作忽略：整理，移动全部，关闭GUI时收回手中物品，
连续合成以及自动重装(自动重装所监视的槽位不受影响)。
注意：按列/行分组仅在剩余未锁定槽位为矩形时才会工作。

inventoryprofiles.config.description.ena.en:
If enabled every server and uniquely named world will have their own locked slots.
Notice:
1. If you tend to name all your worlds "New World" they will all share the same locked slots.
2. Servers behind bungee cord/velocity proxies will share locked slots.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.ena.zh:
如果启用，每个服务器和唯一命名的世界将拥有独立的锁定槽位。
注意：
1.如果你把所有的世界都命名为"新的世界"，它们将共享同一个锁定槽位。
2.bungeecord/velocity代理的服务器将共享锁定槽位。

inventoryprofiles.config.description.vil.en:
Toggles villager trading enhancements.

This allows you to bookmark one or more type of trades.
And do all possible trades for these types
with a single click.

There are 2 types of bookmarks Global and Local.
 - Global select the trade type for all villagers with the same profession.
 - Local select the trade for the active villager only.

Bookmarks also work for Wandering Traders but they only have Global type.
The color used to highlight the locally bookmarked trades.
The color used to highlight the globally bookmarked trades.
Enables second Global/Local group of bookmarks
The color used to highlight the second local group of bookmarked trades.
The color used to highlight the second global group of bookmarked trades.
Enables third Global/Local group of bookmarks
The color used to highlight the third local group of bookmarked trades.
The color used to highlight the third global group of bookmarked trades.

inventoryprofiles.config.description.ena.en:
Display message if a new version of the mod is available. To do the check we send to our servers ONLY the following information:
	Minecraft Version, Fabric or Forge, Inventory Profiles Next version.
Your IP address is not saved!
inventoryprofiles.config.description.ena.zh:
当模组有新版本可用时，会向你显示信息。为了进行检查，会向服务器发送以下信息:
	Minecraft版本，Fabric或是Forge，Inventory Profiles Next版本。
你的IP地址没有被保存!

inventoryprofiles.config.description.ena.en:
Enable Analytics.
Only information about the mod and which features are used is collected.
NO Personal information is sent. Your IP address is not stored.
None of the collected information will be shared, sold or transferred to anyone!
inventoryprofiles.config.description.ena.zh:
只有关于mod和已开启的功能的信息会被收集。
不会发送个人信息。你的IP地址也没有被保存。
收集的信息不会被共享、出售或转让给任何人!

inventoryprofiles.config.name.auto_craft.en: Wait Ticks Before Next Craft Click

inventoryprofiles.config.name.move_all_a.zh: 移动鼠标指向区域的全部物品

inventoryprofiles.config.name.ignore_dur.zh: 移动/扔出时忽略物品耐久

inventoryprofiles.config.description.for.en: This enables a category with very rudimentary tools for managing GUI Integration Hints.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.for.zh: 这个选项将会启用一个类别，其中包含管理GUI集成提示的基本工具。

inventoryprofiles.config.description.add.en:
Adds some time between clicks while sorting/moving. 
The amount of time is controlled by "Interval Between Clicks (in Milliseconds)". 

This might be useful on some servers that don't like fast clicks.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.add.zh:
增加整理和移动时的点击间隔。通过"点击间隔(ms)"设置间隔时间。
这可能在一些不喜欢快速点击的服务器上有用。

inventoryprofiles.config.description.int.en:
Interval between clicks, in milliseconds. 
For some servers 67 or more is recommended.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.int.zh:
点击之间的时间(ms)
(为了绕过一些服务器，推荐设置为67ms或更高)

inventoryprofiles.config.description.aut.en:
Wait this number of client ticks before doing next craft while auto-crafting.
Increase this if auto-crafting stops before it uses all available resources.
This is server ping dependent. The higher the ping the higher the value is needed.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.aut.zh:
自动合成时，下一次合成前等待的客户端时间(tick)。
如果自动合成在所有材料耗尽前停止，请增大此值。
此值与服务器ping值(延迟)有关，ping值越高，此值需要越大。

inventoryprofiles.config.description.con.en:
Method 2 is pre 1.3.7 behaviour, Method 1 is post 1.3.7.
Method 1 is better overall, but Method 2 works better on some servers.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.con.zh:
方法 2 是1.3.7版本之前的行为方式，方法 1 则是1.3.7版本之后的方式。
方法 1 更好，但在部分服务器中方法 2 更有效。

inventoryprofiles.config.description.res.en: The hotbar will be restocked during the sort procedure.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.res.zh: 整理时会补货快捷栏的物品

inventoryprofiles.config.description.sor.en:
If this is true, using sort hotkey will sort the slots that under the cursor.
Default behavior is to always sort the opened container.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.sor.zh:
当此选项开启时，按下整理热键将整理鼠标指向区域。
默认情况下会整理打开的容器。

inventoryprofiles.config.description.mov.en:
When this is true "Move All" hotkey move from slots under the cursor. 
When false it will always move from player to container.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.mov.zh:
当此选项开启时，"移动全部"热键会移动鼠标指向区域的物品。
关闭时，则总是把物品从物品栏移动到容器。

inventoryprofiles.config.description.sto.en:
If "Add Interval Between Clicks" is enabled sort operation could take long time. If we are sorting the player inventory it is possible to continue even if the inventory screen is closed. 
This setting controls whether we should stop the sort process if the screen is closed.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.sto.zh:
当"增加点击的间隔"开启时，整理操作可能会花费很长时间。
当物品栏界面关闭时，整理玩家物品栏的进程可能仍在继续。
此设置控制物品栏界面关闭时是否停止整理。

inventoryprofiles.config.description.ign.en: If set to true Move Matching and Throw Matching operations will ignore the item durability when deciding what to move or throw.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.ign.zh: 当此选项开启时，移动相符物品和扔出相符物品的操作将会忽略物品耐久。

inventoryprofiles.config.name.enable_inv.zh: 在物品栏中启用设置按钮

inventoryprofiles.config.description.ena.en: When enabled a small button will appear in the to left of the screen that will the Inventory Profiles Settings.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.ena.zh: 启用后，屏幕左侧将出现一个小按钮，该按钮将显示任务栏配置文件设置

inventoryprofiles.config.description.ena.en: When enabled a small button will appear in the to left of the screen that will open the IPN Overlay Editor.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.ena.zh: 当此选项开启时，屏幕左侧会出现一个小按钮，点击可以打开IPN的覆盖编辑器。

inventoryprofiles.config.name.enable_pro.zh: 开启档案改变/应用通知

inventoryprofiles.config.description.ena.en:
This enables small 3 button user interface under the player inventory screen that can be used to switch between profiles and apply the currently active one.
All of the Gui functions are available as shortcuts.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.ena.zh:
当此选项开启时，将在玩家物品栏界面下的添加3个按钮，用于在不同档案间切换以及应用当前选中的档案。
所有的Gui功能都可以作为快捷方式使用。

inventoryprofiles.config.description.pro.en: The current profile is announced with a text popup just over the Hotbar.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.pro.zh: 当前的档案将在快捷栏上方弹出文本进行同志。

inventoryprofiles.config.name.treat_unkn.en: Add Inventory Buttons to All In Game Screens
inventoryprofiles.config.name.treat_unkn.zh: 在所有游戏内界面中添加物品栏按钮

inventoryprofiles.config.name.show_sort_.zh: 显示 "按列整理" 按钮
显示 "按行整理" 按钮

inventoryprofiles.config.name.show_move_.zh: 显示 "移动全部" 按钮

inventoryprofiles.config.description.ena.en: This controls whether we add our buttons to the container screen.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.ena.zh: 此设置控制是否添加按钮到容器界面

inventoryprofiles.config.description.tre.en:
This is mostly for compatibility with other mods that have introduce screens which are not real inventory.
Setting this to false will disable the inserting of widgets for all but vanilla screens.

NOTE: This is deprecated and will be removed in version 1.2.0.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.tre.zh:
这主要是为了兼容其他mod中不带有真正物品栏的介绍界面。
此设置关闭时将取消所有原版界面外的插入小部件。

注意：此选项已弃用，将在1.2.0版本中移除。

inventoryprofiles.config.description.sho.en:
Show continuous crafting checkbox in crafting table and survival inventory.
"Continuous Crafting" will auto refill the recipe ingredients in the crafting grid.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.sho.zh:
在合成台和生存模式物品栏中显示连续合成复选框
"连续合成" 会自动重装配方物品到合成网格中。

inventoryprofiles.config.description.con.en: This setting controls if the checkbox state is preserved after the screen is closed or is always reset to the configured value below.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.con.zh: 此设置控制复选框状态在界面关闭后是否保存，或者总是重置为下方的配置值。

inventoryprofiles.config.description.con.en: The saved/default value of the "Continuous Crafting" checkbox.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.con.zh: 当前保存/默认的 "连续合成" 复选框的值

inventoryprofiles.config.description.sho.en: Show "Sort" button in the container/player Gui.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.sho.zh: 在容器/玩家Gui中显示 "整理" 按钮

inventoryprofiles.config.description.reg.en: Set the post action for "Sort" button.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.reg.zh: 设置 "整理" 按钮的整理操作

inventoryprofiles.config.description.reg.en: Set the sort order for "Sort" button.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.reg.zh: 设置 "整理" 按钮的整理规则

inventoryprofiles.config.description.reg.en: Set the custom rule for "Sort" button.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.reg.zh: 设置 "整理" 按钮的自定义规则操作

inventoryprofiles.config.description.sho.en: Show the "Sort in Columns" button in the container/player Gui.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.sho.zh: 在容器/玩家Gui中显示 "按列整理" 按钮

inventoryprofiles.config.description.in_.en: Set the post action for "Sort in Columns" button
inventoryprofiles.config.description.in_.zh: 设置 "按列整理" 按钮的整理操作

inventoryprofiles.config.description.in_.en: Set the sort order for "Sort in Columns" button
inventoryprofiles.config.description.in_.zh: 设置 "按列整理" 按钮的整理规则

inventoryprofiles.config.description.in_.en: Set the custom rule for sort in columns button
inventoryprofiles.config.description.in_.zh: 设置 "按列整理" 按钮的自定义规则操作

inventoryprofiles.config.description.sho.en: Show "Sort in Rows" button in the container/player Gui.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.sho.zh: 在容器/玩家Gui中显示 "按行整理" 按钮

inventoryprofiles.config.description.in_.en: Set the post action for "Sort in Rows" button.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.in_.zh: 设置 "按行整理" 按钮的整理操作

inventoryprofiles.config.description.in_.en: Set the sort order for "Sort in Rows" button.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.in_.zh: 设置 "按行整理" 按钮的整理规则

inventoryprofiles.config.description.in_.en: Set the custom rule for "Sort in Rows" button.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.in_.zh: 设置 "按行整理" 按钮的自定义规则操作

inventoryprofiles.config.description.sho.en: Show "Move All" buttons in the container/player Gui.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.sho.zh: 在容器/玩家Gui中显示 "移动全部" 按钮

inventoryprofiles.config.name.auto_refil.en: Number of Ticks to Wait Before Auto Refill
Disable Refill for Tools While Holding

inventoryprofiles.config.name.allow_brea.en: Allow Some Non Enchanted Gear to Break

inventoryprofiles.config.description.typ.en: Controls what type of visual alert is used when a tool can't be replaced.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.typ.zh: 控制工具替换失败时的视觉提示类型

inventoryprofiles.config.description.aud.en: If enabled you will get sound alert when a tool replace was unsuccessful.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.aud.zh: 如果开启，当工具替换失败时你将收到声音提示。

inventoryprofiles.config.description.vis.en: If enabled you will get visual alert when a tool replace was unsuccessful.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.vis.zh: 如果开启，当工具替换失败时你将收到视觉提示。

inventoryprofiles.config.description.typ.en: Controls what type of visual alert is used when a tool have been replaced.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.typ.zh: 控制工具替换成功时的视觉提示类型

inventoryprofiles.config.description.aud.en: If enabled you will get sound alert when a tool is replaced because of depleted durability.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.aud.zh: 如果开启，当工具因耐久不足替换成功时你将收到声音提示。

inventoryprofiles.config.description.vis.en: If enabled you will get visual alert when a tool is replaced because of depleted durability.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.vis.zh: 如果开启，当工具因耐久不足替换成功时你将收到视觉提示。

inventoryprofiles.config.description.num.en: How many notification you will get before the switch
inventoryprofiles.config.description.num.zh: 在切换前你会收到多少次提醒

inventoryprofiles.config.description.aud.en: If enabled a specific sound will be played when a tool durability is close to switch point.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.aud.zh: 如果开启，当工具耐久接近切换值时将播放特定的音效。

inventoryprofiles.config.description.typ.en: Controls what type of visual alert is used in case a tool durability is close to switch point.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.typ.zh: 控制工具耐久接近切换值时的视觉提示类型

inventoryprofiles.config.description.vis.en: This enables visual notifications when a tool/armor durability is getting close to the level for replacement.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.vis.zh: 如果开启，当工具耐久接近切换值时将有视觉上的提示。

inventoryprofiles.config.description.ena.en: Refill the active item when the stack runs out.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.ena.zh: 当物品用尽时重装手中物品

inventoryprofiles.config.description.dis.zh: 对扔出物品禁用 "自动重装"

inventoryprofiles.config.description.ign.en: Allow Auto Refill to use items from locked slots.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.ign.zh: 允许自动重装使用锁定槽位中的物品

inventoryprofiles.config.description.aut.en: Be default the stack with most items in it will be used for auto refill. If this is set to `true` the smallest available will be used first.

inventoryprofiles.config.description.ref.en: Refill armor slots if items are about to break
inventoryprofiles.config.description.ref.zh: 当护甲即将损坏时重装护甲栏

inventoryprofiles.config.description.ref.en:
Refill tools and armor before they break.
See "Damage Threshold" for more information.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.ref.zh:
在工具和护甲损坏前自动重装
更多信息参见 "耐久阈值"

inventoryprofiles.config.description.dis.en:
Disable replacement of Loyalty enchanted gear.
When this is true anything that is enchanted with any level of Loyalty
 will not be replaced when thrown or dropped.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.dis.zh:
取消对忠诚附魔装备的替换。
当此选项开启时，任何有忠诚附魔的装备在抛出或扔出时不会被替换。

inventoryprofiles.config.description.aut.en:
Auto refill will take Custom Names into account when refilling blocks
For gear custom names are ignored.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.aut.zh:
重装方块时，自动填充将考虑自定义名称
对于装备自定义名称被忽略。

inventoryprofiles.config.description.aut.en:
Auto refill will take NBT into account when refilling blocks
For gear NBT is ignored.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.aut.zh:
重装方块时，自动填充将考虑NBT
对于装备NBT被忽略。

inventoryprofiles.config.description.aut.en:
This controls how is NBT compared.
'Exact' means that NBT must fully match.
'Allow Extra' means that only tags that are the same will be compared.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.aut.zh:
这控制如何比较NBT。
'精准'表示NBT必须完全匹配。
'允许附加'表示只比较相同的标签。

inventoryprofiles.config.description.aut.en: If this is set to false Fish and Axolotl buckets will only refill if they contain the same type of Fish/Axolotl.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.aut.zh: 如果将其设置为关鱼和美西螈桶只有在它们包含相同类型的鱼/美西螈时才会重装

inventoryprofiles.config.description.aut.en:
When this is set to true when a food item stack is depleted any other food item can be used to refill it.

NOTE:
This will sort the food items by saturation, i.e. and enchanted golden apple will be the first choice. And so on...
inventoryprofiles.config.description.aut.zh:
当此值设置为开时，当一组食物耗尽时，可以使用任何其他食物来补充它。

注意：
这将按饱和度对食物物品进行排序，即附魔金苹果将是首选。等等...

inventoryprofiles.config.description.aut.en: When this and the above are set to true, harmful foods, like 'puffer fish', will also be uset to refill depleted food stacks.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.aut.zh: 当此值和上面的选项设置为开时，有害食物，如“河豚”，也将被用来补充耗尽的一组食物。

inventoryprofiles.config.description.aut.en:
Comma separated list of item types to that will be ignored by Auto refill
For example 'minecraft:golden_axe,minecraft:stone'
WARNING:
To avoid performance degradation DO NOT put too many item types in the list!
inventoryprofiles.config.description.aut.zh:
将被自动重装忽略的物品种类列表，以逗号进行分隔。
例如：'minecraft:golden_axe,minecraft:stone'
警告：
为了避免性能下降，不要在列表中添加过多的物品种类！

inventoryprofiles.config.description.too.en: Controls the durability level that will trigger auto refill.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.too.zh: 控制触发自动重装的耐久等级

inventoryprofiles.config.description.thr.en:
Set the unit for "Damage Threshold".
Absolute value and percentage (%%) are supported.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.thr.zh:
设置 "耐久阈值" 的单位
支持绝对值和百分比(%%)

inventoryprofiles.config.description.aut.en:
Auto refill will wait this many ticks before doing the swap. 
This might be useful on some during high server lag. 
However, depending on the "Damage Threshold" value, the tool might break before a swap is initiated.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.aut.zh:
自动重装在交换前将等待的时间(ticks)
这可能在一些高卡顿的服务器中有用。
然而，根据 "耐久阈值" 的值，工具可能在交换开始之前就发生损坏。

inventoryprofiles.config.description.aut.en: Holding this key will disable auto refill for tools this allows you to break tools if you want to.

inventoryprofiles.config.description.all.en:
Don't try to save non enchanted items.
That has maximum durability less than the setting below.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.all.zh:
不再尝试保存无附魔物品。
最大耐久值低于下方的设置的物品将不再保存。

inventoryprofiles.config.description.too.en:
Tools with maximum durability below this value will be allowed to break if the setting above is true.
The idea that most players don't really want to keep stone tools,
 but will be annoyed if they break a diamond one.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.too.zh:
当上方的设置开启时，最大耐久低于此值的工具将允许被破坏
这个选项是因为大多数玩家并不像保存石制工具，而在钻石工具损坏时又会感到懊恼。

inventoryprofiles.config.name.also_show_.en: Also Show Locked Slots in Hotbar
inventoryprofiles.config.name.also_show_.zh: 同时显示快捷栏锁定槽位

inventoryprofiles.config.name.locked_slo.zh: 允许在快捷栏中的物品

inventoryprofiles.config.description.loc.en:
A list of item ids that will be allowed to be picked up into the hotbar

The format is 'namespace:item' so if you want stone to be allowed you need to add 'minecraft:stone'
if the name doesn't contain ':' it will be considered that the whole namespace is allowed.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.loc.zh:
允许被拾取到快捷栏中的物品ID的列表

格式是'命名空间:物品'所以如果你想让石头被允许，你需要添加'minecraft:stone'
如果名称不包含':'将考虑允许所有命名空间。

inventoryprofiles.config.name.locked_slo.en: Disable Shift+Click and Ctrl+Q and Q
Disable (Q) Drop For Non-Stackable Locked Slots In Game
inventoryprofiles.config.name.locked_slo.zh: 不可堆叠物品禁用扔出(Q)

inventoryprofiles.config.name.locked_slo.en: Enable Picking Items into Empty Locked Slots
inventoryprofiles.config.name.locked_slo.zh: 开启锁定槽位拾取物品

inventoryprofiles.config.name.locked_slo.en: Maximum Ticks to Wait on Dimension Change
inventoryprofiles.config.name.locked_slo.zh: 维度改变最大等待时间

inventoryprofiles.config.name.lock_slots.en: Disable All User Input on Locked Slots
inventoryprofiles.config.name.lock_slots.zh: 锁定槽位禁止所有用户输入

inventoryprofiles.config.name.locked_slo.en: Pick Items Directly into the Inventory
inventoryprofiles.config.name.locked_slo.zh: 将物品直接捡到到物品栏中

inventoryprofiles.config.description.loc.en: Config lock slots by "Config Key" while holding this key (Default Alt + Left Click to config lock slots)
inventoryprofiles.config.description.loc.zh: 按住"配置热键"来配置锁定槽位 (默认使用 Alt + 鼠标左键 来配置锁定槽位)

inventoryprofiles.config.description.loc.en: Config lock slots while holding modifier key (Default Alt + Left Click to config lock slots)
inventoryprofiles.config.description.loc.zh: 按住热键时配置锁定槽位 (默认使用 Alt + 鼠标左键 来配置锁定槽位)

inventoryprofiles.config.description.loc.en: Config lock slots without holding modifier key
inventoryprofiles.config.description.loc.zh: 不按"配置热键"即可配置锁定槽位

inventoryprofiles.config.description.loc.en: Quick disable lock slots when this key is being held down
inventoryprofiles.config.description.loc.zh: 按下此键来暂时关闭锁定槽位

inventoryprofiles.config.description.loc.en: Set config switch type to toggle or hold
inventoryprofiles.config.description.loc.zh: 设置配置开关类型为切换或按住

inventoryprofiles.config.description.sho.en: Color to use to highlight locked hotbar slots in the HUD
inventoryprofiles.config.description.sho.zh: 用于突出显示HUD中锁定的快捷栏槽的颜色

inventoryprofiles.config.description.sho.en: The color used as background of locked slots.

Draw locked slots foreground

You can create your own texture and put it in
resourcepacks/§o[pack_name]§r/assets/inventoryprofilesnext/textures/gui/overlay.png
inventoryprofiles.config.description.sho.zh:
显示锁定槽位前景

你可以创建自己的材质然后把它放在
resourcepacks/§o[pack_name]§r/assets/inventoryprofilesnext/textures/gui/overlay.png

inventoryprofiles.config.description.als.en: When enabled locked slots are also rendered in the HUD Hotbar
inventoryprofiles.config.description.als.zh: 当启用锁定槽位时也将在快捷栏HUD中显示。

inventoryprofiles.config.description.loc.en:
Select foreground style from preset

You can create your own texture and put it in
resourcepacks/§o[pack_name]§r/assets/inventoryprofilesnext/textures/gui/overlay.png
inventoryprofiles.config.description.loc.zh:
从预设中选择前景风格

你可以创建自己的材质然后把它放在
resourcepacks/§o[pack_name]§r/assets/inventoryprofilesnext/textures/gui/overlay.png

inventoryprofiles.config.description.loc.en:
In the inventory screen locked slots will be immune to:
 - Shift+Click
 - Ctrl+Q
 - Swipe Shift+Click
 - Swipe Ctrl+Q
inventoryprofiles.config.description.loc.zh:
在物品栏界面锁定槽位将忽略以下操作：
 - Shift+点击
 - Ctrl+Q
 - Shift+点击+划动
 - Ctrl+Q+划动

inventoryprofiles.config.description.loc.en:
Disables Drop operations for hotbar locked slots while in game.
Stopping you from throwing your pickaxe in lava.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.loc.zh:
禁用在游戏内时对快捷栏锁定槽位的扔出操作。
防止你把镐子扔进熔岩里。

inventoryprofiles.config.description.loc.en:
Should it be possible to pick items from the ground into EMPTY locked slots.
Stackable items will still be picked into locked sots of the same item that have room.
NOTE: See next setting description for more information!
inventoryprofiles.config.description.loc.zh:
是否可以拾取物品到空的锁定槽位中。
在此选项禁用时，可堆叠的物品仍会拾取到已被占据的锁定槽位中。
注意：查看下一项设置的描述来了解更多信息！

inventoryprofiles.config.description.loc.en:
This will try to pickup items directly into the inventory instead of taking empty slot from the hotbar.
NOTE: For this to work "Enable Picking Items into Empty Locked Slots" must be set to "false"!
inventoryprofiles.config.description.loc.zh:
这将尝试将物品直接拾取到物品栏中而不是从快捷栏中取出空槽。
注意：为了这能工作"开启锁定槽位拾取物品"必须为"关"!

inventoryprofiles.config.description.loc.en:
The maximum number of client ticks to wait for the server to send the content of the player inventory. 
If locked slots get items moved out/thrown away on dimension change you need to increase this value.
This often happens on servers under heavy load.
NOTE: 20 ticks are equivalent of 1 second.
§l§cWARNING§r: Setting this too high MAY lead to locked slot management not working properly until this timeout expires.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.loc.zh:
等待服务器发送玩家物品栏内容的最大客户端时间(ticks)
如果锁定槽位在维度改变时物品被移出/丢出，则需要增大这个值。
这种情况经常发生在负载过重的服务器上。
注意：20 ticks相当于1秒。
§l§c警告§r：设置过高的值可能会导致锁定槽位无法正常工作，直到超时。

inventoryprofiles.config.description.loc.en:
The idea is that any user actions on locked slots will be disabled.
Essentially you will need to unlock it before moving, or performing any other action on the item.
Automated actions, profiles, auto refill and so on, are not affected
inventoryprofiles.config.description.loc.zh:
意思是，任何对锁定槽位的用户操作都将被无效。
基本上，你需要在移动物品或执行任何其他操作之前进行解锁。
自动操作、profiles、自动重装等不受影响。

inventoryprofiles.config.description.qui.en: The name of the Profile that will be accessible with Quick Profile 1 hot key.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.qui.zh: 可通过快捷档案 1 热键访问的档案的名称

inventoryprofiles.config.description.qui.en: The name of the Profile that will be accessible with Quick Profile 2 hot key.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.qui.zh: 可通过快捷档案 2 热键访问的档案的名称

inventoryprofiles.config.description.qui.en: The name of the Profile that will be accessible with Quick Profile 3 hot key.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.qui.zh: 可通过快捷档案 3 热键访问的档案的名称

inventoryprofiles.config.name.include_cu.en: Include custom names in the 'Saved' profiles

inventoryprofiles.config.description.inc.en:
If this is enabled the custom item names will be included in the 'Saved' profiles.
This is NOT recommended for general use, but it's useful is some cases like having a profiles with different backpacks or some other type of storage.

When it comes to normal gear matching by enchantments is the best approach.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.inc.zh:
如果启用，保存的档案中将会包含自定义物品名称。
一般情况下不推荐使用，但在一些情况下(档案中有不同的背包或其他类型的存储空间)，它能发挥作用。
对于普通的装备来说，通过附魔进行匹配是最好的方法。

inventoryprofiles.config.description.scr.en:
If you hold this key while using the scroll to chest/player keys the full stack will be scrolled not just 1 item.
NOTE:
This modifies the behaviour of the options below to work on a stack level not on single item.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.scr.zh:
如果你在使用滚动到箱子/玩家时按住此键，整组将被滚动，而不仅仅是1个物品。
注意:
这会修改以下选项的行为以在一组级别上工作而不是单个项目。

inventoryprofiles.config.description.scr.en: If you hold this key while using the scroll to chest/player keys the 1 item from the source stack will be left in the original slot
inventoryprofiles.config.description.scr.zh: 如果你在使用滚动到箱子/玩家时按住此键，原组中的一个物品将留在原始位置

inventoryprofiles.config.description.scr.en: If you hold this key while using the scroll to chest/player keys All free target slots will be filled with the same or almost the same amount of items
inventoryprofiles.config.description.scr.zh: 如果你在使用滚动到箱子/玩家时按住此键，所有空闲的目标位置都将被相同或几乎相同数量的物品填充

inventoryprofiles.config.description.scr.en:
If you hold this key while using the scroll to chest/player keys the items will be dropped out of the inventory and opened container.
NOTE:
The direction is ignored.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.scr.zh:
如果你在使用滚动到箱子/玩家时按住此键，物品将从物品栏中扔出并打开容器
注意:
方向被忽略。

inventoryprofiles.config.description.scr.en: If this is true a new stack will be picked up if the current stack in cursor ends while scrolling the cursor items
inventoryprofiles.config.description.scr.zh: 如果为开，光标中的一组物品用完时将会捡起新的一组自动填充光标

inventoryprofiles.config.name.save_as_pr.en: Save the current state as "Saved" Profile
inventoryprofiles.config.name.save_as_pr.zh: 保存当前状态为 "Saved" 档案

inventoryprofiles.config.name.scroll_to_.en: Scroll Items From Player to Chest
inventoryprofiles.config.name.scroll_to_.zh: 将物品从玩家滚动到箱子

inventoryprofiles.config.name.scroll_to_.en: Scroll Items From Chest to Player
inventoryprofiles.config.name.scroll_to_.zh: 将物品从箱子滚动到玩家

inventoryprofiles.config.description.glo.en: Adds the trade under the mouse cursor as a global bookmark.

inventoryprofiles.config.description.loc.en: Adds the trade under the mouse cursor as a local bookmark.

inventoryprofiles.config.description.do_.en: Executes all possible globally bookmarked trades.
Executes all possible locally bookmarked trades.

inventoryprofiles.config.description.glo.en: Adds the trade under the mouse cursor as a global bookmark in group 2.

inventoryprofiles.config.description.loc.en: Adds the trade under the mouse cursor as a local bookmark in group 2.

inventoryprofiles.config.description.do_.en: Executes all possible globally bookmarked trades from group 2.
Executes all possible locally bookmarked trades from group 2..

inventoryprofiles.config.description.glo.en: Adds the trade under the mouse cursor as a global bookmark in group 3.

inventoryprofiles.config.description.loc.en: Adds the trade under the mouse cursor as a local bookmark in group 3.

inventoryprofiles.config.description.do_.en: Executes all possible globally bookmarked trades from group 3.
Executes all possible locally bookmarked trades from group 3.

inventoryprofiles.config.description.sav.en:
This hotkey saves the current equipment set as a Profile named "Saved".
You can use the Saved profiles to build your own profiles.

§l§cNOTE§r:
EVERY TIME you press it a new Profile named "Saved" is created.
The "Saved" profiles will not be part of the next/previous rotation and cannot be assigned to Quick Profiles.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.sav.zh:
此快捷键将保存当前装备套装为名为"Saved"的档案
你可以使用这个档案来构筑你自己的档案

§l§c注意：§r
每一次你按下这个按键时都将创建一个新的名为"Saved"的档案。
"Saved"档案不能通过下一个/上一个档案进行转换，不能被设置为快捷档案。

inventoryprofiles.config.description.nex.en: Hotkey for changing to the next profile.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.nex.zh: 切换到下一档案的快捷键

inventoryprofiles.config.description.pre.en: Hotkey for changing to the previous profile.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.pre.zh: 切换到上一档案的快捷键

inventoryprofiles.config.description.pro.en:
Hotkey for changing to Quick Profile 1.
You can configure the Quick Profiles in the Edit Profiles config page.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.pro.zh:
切换到快捷档案 1的快捷键
你可以在档案编辑配置页面配置快捷档案

inventoryprofiles.config.description.pro.en:
Hotkey for changing to Quick Profile 2.
You can configure the Quick Profiles in the Edit Profiles config page.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.pro.zh:
切换到快捷档案 2的快捷键
你可以在档案编辑配置页面配置快捷档案

inventoryprofiles.config.description.pro.en:
Hotkey for changing to Quick Profile 3.
You can configure the Quick Profiles in the Edit Profiles config page.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.pro.zh:
切换到快捷档案 3的快捷键
你可以在档案编辑配置页面配置快捷档案

inventoryprofiles.config.description.ope.en: The key open the in-game configuration.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.ope.zh: 打开游戏内配置界面的快捷键

inventoryprofiles.config.description.sor.en: The key to sort the inventory.
The key to sort the inventory in columns.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.sor.zh: 按列整理物品栏的快捷键

inventoryprofiles.config.description.sor.en: The key to sort the inventory in rows.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.sor.zh: 按行整理物品栏的快捷键

inventoryprofiles.config.description.mov.en: The key to move all/matching the items that already existed in the container
inventoryprofiles.config.description.mov.zh: 移动容器内所有已有物品的快捷键

inventoryprofiles.config.description.thr.en:
The key to throw all/matching items for either player inventory or the opened container.Generally useful for mass crafting.
All modifier keys for Move All Items apply here too.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.thr.zh:
扔出玩家物品栏或打开容器中所有物品的快捷键。通常用于批量合成。
移动全部物品的所有快捷键也适用于这里。

inventoryprofiles.config.description.dum.en: Prints the item string with nbt to the chat.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.dum.zh: 输出物品字符串(含NBT)到聊天栏

inventoryprofiles.config.description.ope.en: Show configuration screen for Inventory Profiles Next GUI overlay
inventoryprofiles.config.description.ope.zh: 显示Inventory Profiles Next的Gui覆盖的配置界面

inventoryprofiles.config.description.rel.en:
This hotkey can be used for faster config reloading when you are defining new custom rules.
In ANY other case it's recommended to keep it unset.
Reloading the configurations is not something you want to do often.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.rel.zh:
当你定义新的自定义规则时，这个快捷键可以用于快速重载配置。
在任何情况下，建议保持为未设置状态。
重载配置不会是你希望经常做的事。

inventoryprofiles.config.description.scr.en: When you press this key while the cursor is over a non empty slot or you hold a item stack in the cursor a single item will be transferred to the opened container.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.scr.zh: 当你在光标所指的非空的槽位时按住此键或者你在光标中有一组物品或一个物品将被转移到打开的容器中。

inventoryprofiles.config.description.scr.en: When you press this key while the cursor is over a non empty slot or you hold a item stack in the cursor a single item will be transferred to the player inventory.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.scr.zh: 当你在光标所指的非空的槽位时按住此键或者你在光标中有一组物品或一个物品将被转移到玩家物品栏中。

inventoryprofiles.config.name.container_.en: Enable Swipe Moving Items From the Container

inventoryprofiles.config.name.swipe_move.zh: 划动移动合成输出栏物品

inventoryprofiles.config.description.pre.en: Closing GUI will no longer drop the item that holding by the cursor.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.pre.zh: 关闭GUI时不会丢出鼠标所持的物品

inventoryprofiles.config.description.con.en: Allows you to move items for the slots under the cursor while holding shift and left click.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.con.zh: 允许你通过 按住shift和左键 来移动鼠标所指的物品

inventoryprofiles.config.description.swi.en: Enable "Swipe Moving Items" in crafting result slot.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.swi.zh: 在合成输出栏开启 "划动移动物品"

inventoryprofiles.config.category.modpac.en: YOU NEED TO BE IN SINGLE PLAYER GAME OR THESE WILL CRASH YOUR GAME.
inventoryprofiles.config.category.modpac.zh: 你必须处于单人游戏，否则游戏将会崩溃

inventoryprofiles.config.description.exp.en:
This generates external hints files that can be distributed as part of the modpack.

NOTE: This will also export everything that is build in the mod.

NOTE: You don't really need this if your modpack has no custom blocks/items.
Our discord server is the place to get help :)
inventoryprofiles.config.description.exp.zh:
这将生成外部提示文件，文件可以作为整合包的一部分进行分发。

注意：这也将导出所有在本mod中构建的东西。

注意：如果你的整合包没有自定义的方块/物品，你不需要使用这个选项。
可以到我们的 discord 服务器寻求帮助 :)

inventoryprofiles.config.description.dif.en:
This determines in the build in or external hints will have priority when using the export buttons.

NOTE: You don't really need this if your modpack has no custom blocks/items.
Our discord server is the place to get help :)
inventoryprofiles.config.description.dif.zh:
这决定了在使用导出按钮时，在构建中内部与外部提示何者具有优先级。

注意：如果你的整合包没有自定义的方块/物品，你不需要使用这个选项。
可以到我们的 discord 服务器寻求帮助 :)

inventoryprofiles.config.description.exp.en:
This generates json file with ALL currently loaded hints. The format is only suitable for embedding into the mod it self.

NOTE: You don't really need this if your modpack has no custom blocks/items.
Our discord server is the place to get help :)
inventoryprofiles.config.description.exp.zh:
这将生成json文件，包含当前所有加载的提示。此格式只适用于嵌入到本mod。

注意：如果你的整合包没有自定义的方块/物品，你不需要使用这个选项。
可以到我们的 discord 服务器寻求帮助 :)

inventoryprofiles.config.description.mak.en:
This button generate a script of /chat commands that will:
 - try to find all blocks that have a GUIs
 - make a nice platform
 - place every block organized by mod

NOTE: You don't really need this if your modpack has no custom blocks/items.
If you want to try this our discord server is the place to get help :)

WARNING: This requires single player world!
inventoryprofiles.config.description.mak.zh:
这个按钮生成一个 /chat命令 的脚本，它将：
 - 尝试找到所有具有Gui的方块
 - 创建一个很棒的平台
 - 以mod进行分组存放每个方块

注意：如果你的整合包没有自定义的方块/物品，你不需要使用这个选项。
如果你需要，可以到我们的 discord 服务器寻求帮助 :)

警告：这需要单人世界！

inventoryprofiles.tooltip.move_all_butto.en:
§5Hold §o%s§r
§6 - Move Only Items same type
